department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants for September admission apply by February 28 (domestic: July 31).
deadline.quote: For September Admission: International Students Deadline: February 28

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test exists for this field; McMaster Engineering does not require the GRE.

supervisor.value: You can apply without a supervisor, but a faculty member must agree to supervise you before you get an offer; contacting faculty helps.
supervisor.quote: you do not need to have a supervisor to apply for admission | a faculty member must be willing to act as your supervisor in order for you to receive an offer of admission

funding.value: PhD students get about CAD 33,069 a year (2025/26, same for international), above the Engineering minimum of CAD 21,000 plus tuition.
funding.quote: The Department of Materials Science and Engineering offers the following funding for PhD students | International – $33,069.16

also.quote: The Faculty of Engineering has a minimum funding package for full-time domestic and international Doctoral students

entry_route.value: A master's (MASc, MSc or equivalent) in a related field is required; bachelor's holders normally start in the MASc.
entry_route.quote: Master's Degree (MAsc, MSc, or equivalent) in a related field.

gre_general.value: McMaster Engineering does not require GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: No. McMaster Engineering does not require a GRE score.

english_waiver.value: Exempt if your university degree was taught in English, but you must attach proof (a letter from your institution).
english_waiver.quote: Applicants may be exempted from this requirement if they have completed a university degree at which English is the language of instruction (Please attach proof – letter from institution)
